title: URL parameter can generate an invalid request on Safari
body:
If you open the following page under Safari 9.0.2 (under Mac at least) you will see that there is an invalid query generated: http://service.specialized.com/productfinder/specialized\_instantsearch.html?q=\&hPP=100\&idx=\&p=0\&is\_v=1

The query contains an empty index, this is why the query is invalid (see attached screenshot)
![screen shot 2015-12-18 at 21 38 29](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/555866/11906952/8f2985c8-a5d0-11e5-826d-150cec3d6ae5.png)
